steps.name: node:22-bookworm
args: [ -f /workspace/build.flag ] || { echo "nothing to build"; exit 0; }; apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends chromium poppler-utils python3-fonttools fontconfig >/dev/null && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && node ci/verify.js

steps.name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk:slim
args: [ -f /workspace/build.flag ] || { echo "nothing to build"; exit 0; }; if [ "${_DRY_RUN}" = "true" ]; then tar czf /workspace/dist.tgz dist && gcloud storage cp /workspace/dist.tgz gs://virtual-marketer-chat-bot-site-build/dryrun/dist.tgz && touch /workspace/dryrun; fi

steps.name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/docker
args: [ -f /workspace/build.flag ] || { echo "nothing to build"; exit 0; }; [ ! -f /workspace/dryrun ] || { echo "dry run: not deploying"; exit 0; }; TAG=$(cat /workspace/tag); docker build -t europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/virtual-marketer-chat-bot/cloud-run-source-deploy/virtual-marketer-website:$$TAG . && docker push europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/virtual-marketer-chat-bot/cloud-run-source-deploy/virtual-marketer-website:$$TAG

steps.name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk:slim
args: [ -f /workspace/build.flag ] || { echo "nothing to build"; exit 0; }; [ ! -f /workspace/dryrun ] || { echo "dry run: not deploying"; exit 0; }; bash ci/deploy.sh
